mentions.name: Phrasing
mentions.description: A language learning app for learning and maintaining multiple languages in one place. It combines the power of spaced repetition with a frictionless, social-media-like experience and a beautifully designed interface. The builder has used it daily for about 8 months, learning several languages in about an hour a day, and is currently working on a new landing page and marketing assets.
mentions.problem: Learning and maintaining multiple languages is hard to do all in one place; the author wanted spaced repetition combined with a frictionless, enjoyable experience rather than clunky study tools.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Been working on https://phrasing.app for about 18 months now. I wanted a way where I could learn a maintain multiple languages, all in one place.

I wanted the power of spaced repetition, the frictionless experience of social media, and the joy of a beautifully designed application.

mentions.name: Phrasing
mentions.description: A language-learning app for polyglots to study over 120 languages in an effective manner with a beautiful UI. It recently gained an onboarding flow, is refining its search and create experience based on real user usage, and received major performance improvements (100x faster on 5 different axes). Critical algorithm logic is kept in an independent Clojure file compiled and tested with cherry-cljs, with plans to expand to ClojErl and jank for isomorphic Clojure code running in the browser, on a BEAM server, and in a native Swift app. The author uses it daily to study 18 languages, including lower-resourced ones like Maltese, Welsh, and Cantonese, and is preparing for a more public launch.
mentions.source_excerpt: Still working on https://phrasing.app - an app for polyglots to learn over 120 languages in the most effective manner and a beautiful UI.
